  On the order of the Mayor, the regular meeting reconvened at 7:04 p.m.
  The pledge of allegiance was led by Jose A. Gomez, Interim
  Superintendent/President of Pasadena City College.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Victor M. Gordo
  Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Felicia Williams
  Councilmember Tyron Hampton
  Councilmember Justin Jones

Council Minutes  1  10/02/2023
   Staff:  City Manager Miguel Marquez
  City Attorney/City Prosecutor Michele Beal Bagneris
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

CEREMONIAL MATTERS Mayor Gordo spoke on America Sameron, a graduate from Pasadena
  High School, student at Pasadena City College, and an active
  participant with the Pasadena Fire Fighter Explorer Program, who is
  currently recovering from severe second and third degree burns from a
  dune buggy accident in the Nevada desert. The City Council, Jose A.
  Gomez, Interim Superintendent/President of Pasadena City College,
  Dr. Mathew Kodama, Principal of Pasadena High School, and
  Pasadena Fire Chief Chad Augustin, shared words of encouragement
  and well-wishes in her speedy recovery.

  Police Deputy Chief Chute introduced and welcomed the new
  Sergeant-At-Arms, Robert DuBois, and extended appreciation to
  Sergeant Mac Adesina for his recent service as Sergeant-At-Arms.

  Mayor Gordo presented a proclamation to Sara Goldman, Interim
  Accessibility Coordinator, Andrea Jennings, Chair of the Accessibility
  and Disability Commission, and Susan Hoge, President of Pasadena
  Civitan, proclaiming October 2023 as "National Disability Employment
  Awareness Month" in Pasadena. Ms. Goldman, Ms Jennings and Ms.
  Hoge thanked the Mayor and City Council for the proclamation and
  recognition, spoke on the importance of recognizing America's workers
  with disabilities, and provided information on their annual Hire Up
  Pasadena Civitan Employer Recognition event, to be held on October
  12, 2023, at Ability First, Lawrence Frank Center.

  Mayor Gordo presented a proclamation to Officer Mary Hooker and the
  Pasadena Police Department, proclaiming October 2023 as "Pink
  Strong Month" (Breast Cancer Awareness), in Pasadena.

  Mayor Gordo presented a proclamation to Michelle Bagneris, City
  Attorney/City Prosecutor, and Linda Offray, CEO of Shepherd's Door,
  proclaiming October 2023 as "Domestic Violence Awareness Month" in
  Pasadena. Mayor Gordo advocated for the City Council and City staff
  to work together to provide a van for organizations like Shepherds Door
  to transport victims of domestic violence for shelter and other resources
  and assistance.

  Vice Mayor Williams announced that the City of Pasadena in
  partnership with the Peace Over Violence, Shepherd's Door, and
  Huntington Health, are hosting a Women's Empowerment Self-
  Defense Class on October 14, 2023, at Victor Park Community Center.
  Mayor Gordo spoke on the passing of Senator Dianne Feinstein, the
  oldest sitting U.S. Senator and member of Congress, and stated that
  the City Council will adjourn in her memory.

Council Minutes  2  10/02/2023
   Vice Mayor Williams spoke on the passing of Russell Hobbs, president
  of the Pasadena and Foothill chapters of the American Institute of

r  Architects, who was an active volunteer in preserving the heritage of
  Pasadena and Bungalow Heaven, and requested that the City Council
  also adjourn in his memory.

  Mark Jomsky, City Clerk, reported on behalf of the Pasadena Police
  Department, that a Pink Strong Month fundraising event will be held at
  California Pizza Kitchen on October 12, 2023, in support of Breast
  Cancer Awareness.

  City Manager Marquez introduced Koko Panossian, the new Director
  of Parks, Recreations and Community Services; and thanked Lola
  Osborne, Deputy Director of Parks, Recreations and Community
  Services for her work as the Acting Director. Mr. Panossian thanked
  the City Manager and expressed appreciation for the opportunity serve
  the City Council and the community in his new role.

  SPECIAL ITEM  PRESENTATION BY LOS ANGELES COUNTY METROPOLITAN
  TRANSPORTATION AUTHORITY ON THE HIGHWAY SOUNDWALL
  PROGRAM (Public Works Dept.)
  Recommendation: This special item is presented for information only;
  no action is required.

  TonyOlmos, Director of Public Works, and Lourdes Kriste, Metropolitan
  Transportation Authority (Metro) Manager with Complete Streets &
  Highways Countywide Planning and Development Department, jointly
  provided a Powerpoint presentation on Metro's highway Soundwall
  Program, with both responding to questions.
